# Vendored packages

DeepSeek Harness is vendored from `github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`
(MIT). `cordis@4.0.0-rc.13` is used directly from npm; see
`docs/HARNESS.md` for how it integrates, and `packages/orbit/` for Orbit's
`dsh.profile`/`dsh.bundle` stubs (`@orbit/dsh-app`, `@orbit/dsh-web`,
`@orbit/dsh-headless`, `@orbit/dsh-sdk`).
